svg.title: EdgeLab system architecture
svg.desc: A student Raspberry Pi runs the client app with frame reader, SP Agent decision logic, local YOLO worker, and remote worker. The remote worker sends frames through the Router VM to the GPU server running Triton. A separate GPU Load VM stresses the GPU server directly. The Kafka and SeQaM machine orchestrates experiment phases by SSH and collects metrics from the Pi, the Router VM, and the GPU server.
